role: independent nonproducer primary-source and REF1 review

actual_scope.scientific_and_APS_comparison: REF1 Spin-adapted state preparation for quantum chemistry against arXiv:2611.30014v1, selected main text/Table2 and AppendixA/Table3. Other sources have separate assigned reviewers.

findings.detail: UGA relabeling, block-sparse reduced-tensor loading and Clebsch-Gordan return to occupations remain identifiable. Result is a logical resource estimate, with no physical QPU or runtime claim.
51/135× dense and3.4/4.9× abelian comparisons are same-DMRG-state results. Approximate37–38/91–95× dense and3.5–3.6/5.0–5.4× abelian numbers are separated as reference-MPS-fidelity comparisons.
Pages2/6 identify χ1000 reference-MPS overlap rather than exact ground-state error, and state the Fe4S4 energy-convergence condition was not met.

Page6 retains no-ancilla-cap QROAM Toffoli minimization,15-bit rotations, as-published dense baseline without later real-tensor optimization and maximum3.7× ancillary-qubit ratio. Physical error correction, wiring, totalQPE repetitions and physical runtime remain unmeasured.
The <0.2% figure appears in the separately reviewed web editorial as a full basis-transform cost. The derivative PDF does not introduce a conflicting percentage.

Page7 retains all3authors in original order, exact original title in sentence case, arXiv:2611.30014v1 without an eprint year, and an active exact-v1 URL. Original generic entry points are retained separately.
Pages1/2/6/7 opened at actual render size: assigned ref1 text, tables and source entry are readable with no clipping or overlap seen. Full7page visual QA is assigned separately.

limitations: No original DMRG, Qualtran/resource code, QPU experiment or human-reader study was reproduced.
No full proof audit or independent scientific validation of references2–6 is claimed by this reviewer.
This review does not establish deployment, liveURL availability or final archive-copy equality.
